title: Three Fridays and One Short Joke
subtitle: 情感心理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）
meta: 主题语境：情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）　|　核心词汇：humour　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 humour 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1996 the comedian ① enjoyed the humour that no stranger in the theatre would have described, and he said the enjoying was the whole of the Friday. The ② humour, meaning the fun itself and not the joke, ran three Fridays and stayed undescribed in the book; humour, he said, is the only thing in a theatre that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ kind of humour in that theatre had the same short joke beside it, and the ④ humour at the far row, meaning the smile they kept for the children to copy and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Humour, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the comedian said the describing is the part that fills three Fridays.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the humour was the whole of the matter, meaning the relief and not the fun. The ⑥ humour, meaning the relief and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; humour, he said, is either something you enjoy or the only word that means both fun and a relief. He said the relief is the part they remember.

By 2001 the ⑦ humour had become a line in a script, and the script had become an argument about the short joke. The ⑧ humour of the whole thing, the comedian wrote in November, was one theatre and three Fridays of describing; humour, he said, is either the smile at the far row or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ humour I remember is the humour described in the script, which closed in 2003 and is still described as the quietest in the theatre. ⑩ Humour, my mother said in 2005, is the only thing that improves by being described; all humour, she said, is a relief that has agreed to look like fun. She said the relief was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 幽默；诙谐（指剧场里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 幽默；诙谐（指那种笑意本身，与笑话相对）
C. 固定搭配：enjoy the humour 欣赏这份幽默
D. n. 幽默；诙谐（指留给孩子们学的那一个那一种）
E. n. 谐趣之事（抽象总称，指一处剧场的幽默之事）
F. n. 幽默；诙谐（指剧本里写到、被记下的的那一种）
G. n. 放松、宽慰（指一件事里人人都笑却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 宽慰（抽象总称，指人人都笑却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: enjoyed the humour that no stranger in the theatre would have described
The humour, meaning the fun itself and not the joke
Every kind of humour in that theatre
the humour at the far row
the humour was the whole of the matter
the humour had become a line in a script
The humour of the whole thing

answers.why: enjoy the humour 意为“欣赏这份幽默”，1996 年那位喜剧演员把剧场里没有一位陌生人肯描述的一点幽默做了一遍。
humour 意为“幽默；诙谐”，指那种笑意本身而不是笑话，它经过了三个星期五而在簿子上没有被描述。
humour 意为“幽默；诙谐”，指剧场里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一个短短的笑话。
humour 意为“幽默；诙谐”，指最远那排前排留给孩子们学的那一个那一种，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
humour 意为“放松、宽慰”，指一件事里人人都笑却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份放松就是那件事的全部。
humour 意为“宽慰”，指人人都笑却无人提起的那样东西而不是那种笑意，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
humour 意为“幽默；诙谐”，指剧本里写到、被记下的的那一种，到 2001 年这一种成了剧本里的一行。
humour 意为“谐趣之事”，喜剧演员十一月写道，整件事的幽默之事是一处剧场和三个星期五的描述。
humour 意为“幽默；诙谐”，我记得的是剧本里描述过的那一种，2003 年讲完了，至今仍被说成剧场里最安静的一种。
humour 为抽象总称，母亲 2005 年说，幽默是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的笑意。
